title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to 1fb1ced36243 (objectui main tip, Half 1 of #23104)
body:
Part of #23104
Clause-②: no

**The console pin hop `7578323a544e` → `1fb1ced36243`** (objectui `main`, `1fb1ced36243c325acc801bdde26bd096a15f5f5`, exactly that commit, re-read as objectui's `main` tip by `git ls-remote` when the work started). This PR is Half 1 of #23104 only, the pin hop. The card stays open for Half 2, the full browser pass of every runnable `surface:browser` and `surface:mixed` checklist item, which the PM seat runs against this PR's head; merging this PR must not close the card.

The maintainer's order, verbatim:

> objectui pin 更新到最新版，并使用浏览器对前端界面进行完整的测试

**Tier:** no governed surface (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`). 21 files, +267/−56, the same shape as #23061.

## The hop: 11 objectui commits, 116 paths, all on objectui `main`

`10aba37d1` (objectui#12242: field metadata members `FieldSchema` refuses retire as `never`), `0cd322d78` (objectui#12228), `1ce8db8d9` (objectui#12222, CI), `ee5c49171` (objectui#12238), `e5c8ea7fe` (objectui#12243), `51c661e38` (objectui#12248), `e8fc452c3` (objectui#12254), `30c2e4e1d` (objectui#12244), `5dcb101` (objectui#12249, test), `7af0ab378` (objectui#12268) and `1fb1ced36` (objectui#12208 / objectui#12256, CI). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 7578323a544e 1fb1ced36243` exits 0 and `git rev-list --count` reads 11 in the sibling checkout, which is shallow; the range walked completely without a deepen (the bump script's own `--check-walkable` probe said so, and the checkout is still shallow after the run).

## The pin round, as #23061's

**Console Pin Gate steps, run locally** (each exited 0):
1. Client build: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client...` (34 tasks).
2. `scripts/build-console.sh` at the pin: bundle canary present, exactly one zod version literal, "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it", and "Shipped the tracked sdui.manifest.json (recorded at objectui@1fb1ced36243, this pin)". The build was run twice; the second run, after the manifest regeneration below, is the one on disk.
3. `check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@1fb1ced36243)".
4. `check:console-injection --require-stamp`: "the dist carries this tree's copy, and not the published one".

The hop does not break the Console Pin Gate build against current `main`.

**Artefacts that travel with the pin:**
- **Console changeset.** `scripts/bump-objectui.sh 1fb1ced36243… --no-commit` generated `.changeset/console-1fb1ced36243.md`: `@objectstack/console` **minor** (the level the script derived). It has 10 releasing entries, 1 release-nothing and 2 commits with no changeset (listed by subject). `Clause-②: no` was added by hand, as in #23061.
  - **Two entries are breaking by their authors' annotation, and the digest marked only one.** objectui#12254 (`e8fc452c3`) annotates with a `BREAKING (…)` paragraph, which the digest recognised. objectui#12242's `@object-ui/types` changeset (`10aba37d1`) annotates with a heading that opens with a warning sign before the word, `## ⚠️ BREAKING, priced as minor …`, and the digest's block-opener rule does not allow that prefix: `hasBreakingAnnotation` answers `false` on the shipped body and `true` with only the warning sign removed. That entry is marked **BREAKING** by hand in this changeset, and the count line reads 2. The digest itself is not changed here (see Acceptance notes).
  - The script wrote an `adr-0087: TODO` placeholder. It is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, the disposition every earlier pin hop with annotated breaking entries used. Each entry is answered against this tree:
    - objectui#12254 draws a dashboard widget's legacy `component` envelope only for a `metric-card` node. `@objectstack/spec` already refuses `component` and inline `data` on a widget (`QUARANTINED_WIDGET_KEYS`) and declares no `custom` widget; the six dashboard files under `examples/` author no `component` key.
    - objectui#12242 turns nine field metadata members into `never` tombstones and changes the `auto_number` / `object` type values. No package or example here depends on `@object-ui/types` (two code comments name it), no example field authors any of those members, and none declares `type: 'auto_number'` or `type: 'object'`.
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` reads the disposition; `check:objectui-changeset` passes.
- **SDUI manifest.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: 107 components, and unlike #23061 `sdui.manifest.json` is **not** byte-identical across this hop. One value moved: `record:activity`'s `showCompleted` input description gains the sentence "A logged interaction, a task item that points at its source record through source_object / source_id (a logged call, meeting or email), also shows either way." (objectui#12228). Nothing in this repo pins that text. `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is re-recorded at the pin (sha256 `f545b851c4bb…`); `check-sdui-manifest` passes.
- **Lockstep record.** `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-records `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at `1fb1ced36243`. objectui's `packages/sdui-parser` is byte-identical across this hop (`git diff --quiet` exits 0); `check:sdui-lockstep` passes (214 grammar lines, 25 codes, the predicate). **No parser port is owed.**
- **Pin citations, re-measured for this hop only:**
  - Every objectui file named in every asserting record was resolved against the objectui trees at both pins and checked against the hop's 116 changed paths, one file at a time. Bare `index.tsx` names were resolved by context: every one names a `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-tree` or `plugin-grid` shell, none of which changed (the one changed `index.tsx`, `plugin-detail`'s, is cited by no asserting record).
  - **One set of cited files changed, and every cited line in it held:** the `en` / `zh` / `de` packs (objectui#12248 and objectui#12268) gained keys below line 1100 only (`en` +9, `zh` +6, `de` +6), so `calendar.configRequired` held at `en.ts` `:953`, `zh.ts` `:726` and `de.ts` `:706`. The functional-completeness `calendar` row says so.
  - Every other record (40 by script, plus the action-group `params` record and the `FormField.span` describe) cites only byte-identical files, and each gains a hop sentence. The `object-grid` `keyboardNavigation` record's count (15 hit lines against 3 for the control) holds because no line of the hop's diff names `keyboardNavigation`.
  - The six migration entries were recounted with `git grep -o -F`, which reproduces every `7578323a544e` figure (all 14 controls). The corpus is 8642 files, and a superset of 99 names (the 13 lifecycle, 31 metrics and 37 tracing exports, plus 18 key names) reads 0, except the unrelated `Span` 519 and `SpanSchema` 57, unchanged. Controls moved, e.g. `objectstack` 18552 → 18601, `@objectstack/spec` 7649 → 7679, `timeout` 1686 → 1700, `tenant` 1404 → 1415.
  - `check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors`: 55 asserting citations match `1fb1ced36`, and 13 quoted anchors verify against objectui at `1fb1ced36`. `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` was regenerated by `gen:docs` (the describe's pin stamp, two rows); `check:generated` reports all 14 artefacts up to date.
  - Changeset `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-1fb1ced36243.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`.

## Smoke boot, against this branch's built console

`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 39417` from this worktree (`check-dev-prereqs` green, 67 packages): `GET /api/v1/health` answered 200 (`status: ok`, version 17.7.0) about 10 s after launch; `GET /_console/` answered 200 (18552 bytes) and its entry script `./assets/index-D6vu2w50.js` 200; the served build stamp `GET /_console/.objectui-sha` reads `1fb1ced36243c325acc801bdde26bd096a15f5f5`, equal to the new pin; and the served `/_console/sdui.manifest.json` hashes to `f545b851c4bb…`, the recorded sha256. The server was stopped by the two PIDs this run recorded, and the port was free afterwards. No browser pass was run here: that is Half 2.

## Verification (local, at `043b81d13`, after merging `origin/main` at `36b2889cd`)

- `@objectstack/spec` build, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 659 files, 19978 passed, 1 todo; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 125 commands on this diff; each was run and recorded with its exit code, and `--ran` reports "125 derived, 125 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". One self-test, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, first exited 3 (prerequisite not met: its fixture is pinned to commit `621a48760788`, outside this shallow checkout). That commit was fetched (`git fetch --depth=1`) and the self-test re-run green (48 cases); the record carries the re-run.

## Acceptance notes

- **`scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` misses an author's breaking annotation whose heading opens with a warning sign.** `BREAKING_BLOCK_OPENER` allows a heading mark, a bullet and emphasis before the word, but no other prefix, so `## ⚠️ BREAKING, …` (objectui#12242's `@object-ui/types` changeset at objectui `1fb1ced36243`) is not counted and its console-changeset entry is not marked. The ADR-0087 disposition prompt still fired here only because a second entry in the same range was recognised; a range whose only breaking entry used this heading would get no disposition prompt and would publish without a **BREAKING** marker. Reported to the PM seat for filing; not fixed in this PR.
